register.labelZh: SHY 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: shy away 和 shy off 可以描述人或動物因為害怕或遇到突發情況而突然往後退。；shy away from 可以描述某人因緊張或沒有信心而避開工作、對話、人物或挑戰。；do not shy away from 和 have never shied away from 等表達,可以表示某人願意面對困難。；認識 shy off 和 shy from,能幫助你理解故事或對話中出現的較少見用法。
register.summaryEn: Shy away and shy off can describe a person or animal suddenly moving backwards because something is frightening or unexpected. Shy away from can describe avoiding a task, conversation, person or challenge because you feel nervous or unsure. Expressions such as do not shy away from and have never shied away from show that someone is willing to face something difficult. Knowing shy off and shy from can help you understand these less common forms when they appear in stories or conversations.
